newsitem.title: MEXICO: Banca Quadrum Q3 net sharply lower.
newsitem.headline: Banca Quadrum Q3 net sharply lower.

text.p: Mexico's Banca Quadrum reported third quarter net profits of 101,000 pesos compared to 2.77 million pesos in the same period in 1995.
Nine-month net profits were 284,000 pesos compared to 10.53 million pesos in the first nine months of 1995.

"Results for the third quarter were very similar to those reported for the first two quarters of the year," Quadrum said in a statement. "The company continues to attribute this primarily to the cost of carrying repossessed property, past-due loans and other non-revenue generating assets at current market interest rates."
It said the latest results were expressed according to U.S. GAAP accounting principles and added that in the third quarter it created provisions for unrecoverable debt worth two million pesos.
Quadrum said its capitalisation ratio stood at 13.8 percent at the end of September.
